pedidos.instruccion_en: Apply a light blur (about 20%) only to the small word "amua" printed on the yellow box and on the bottle label, so it is softened but still faintly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: headline, the four day panels, the woman, the box and bottle shape, colors and all other label text (VITALDROPS, ingredients), the gold offer box, its texts and the VITALDROPS logo.
pedidos.resumen: Difuminamos un poco la palabra «amua» en la caja y en el frasco. Todo lo demás queda igual.
